facts.text: Selected variant: Single / 72 X 36 (183 cm x 92 cm) / 3 (7.62cm).
The mattress has a high-density HR foam core and a super fine premium knitted fabric cover.
The mattress has a dual-sided design; flip it when one side feels worn.
The foldable design allows easy storage when the mattress is not in use.
The product uses Super Fine Premium knitted fabric, described as soft and breathable.
The mattress is described as lightweight and easy to move.
